[narrowed from route-edit-1e048f7a] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-254dded0: Edit repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts so the GET /bootstrap handler stops returning a loopback identity_endpoint.

The relevant code is the const identity_endpoint assignment inside the app.get("/bootstrap", ...) handler. Today its final fallback is process.env.IDENTITY_VESSEL_URL, which on this deployment is http://127.0.0.1:8101 — so a remote client that fetches /bootstrap is handed an

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- semantic_reject: The patch removes process.env.IDENTITY_VESSEL_URL as a fallback for identity_endpoint within the /bootstrap handler, directly addressing the gap's description of stopping the return of a loopback iden
- semantic_reject: The patch removes IDENTITY_VESSEL_URL as a fallback for identity_endpoint but doesn't ensure the code path executes and still allows loopback through other fallbacks.

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
